blocks.body: Imagine you are looking up at the top of Qutub Minar. Can you find its height without actually measuring it with a tape? Yes! By knowing just the angle at which you are looking up and your distance from the base. This magic is called **Trigonometry** — the mathematics of triangles!
blocks.body_hi: कल्पना करें कि आप कुतुब मीनार के शीर्ष को देख रहे हैं। क्या आप बिना टेप के इसे मापे इसकी ऊँचाई ज्ञात कर सकते हैं? हाँ! केवल उस कोण को जानकर जिससे आप ऊपर देख रहे हैं और आधार से आपकी दूरी। इस जादू को **त्रिकोणमिति** कहते हैं!
blocks.body_gu: વિચારો કે તમે કુતુબમિનારની ટોચ જોઈ રહ્યા છો. શું તમે ટેપથી માપ્યા વિના તેની ઊંચાઈ શોધી શકો છો? હા! માત્ર તમે કયા ખૂણે જુઓ છો અને પાયાથી તમારું અંતર જાણીને. આ જાદુને **ત્રિકોણમિતિ** કહેવાય છે!

blocks.body:
**8.2 Trigonometric Ratios**

In a right triangle ABC (right-angled at B), for angle A:
- **sin A** = (side opposite to A) / hypotenuse = BC / AC
- **cos A** = (side adjacent to A) / hypotenuse = AB / AC
- **tan A** = (side opposite to A) / (side adjacent to A) = BC / AB

Reciprocal ratios:
- **cosec A** = 1 / sin A = AC / BC
- **sec A** = 1 / cos A = AC / AB
- **cot A** = 1 / tan A = AB / BC

Also remember: tan A = sin A / cos A.
blocks.body_hi:
**8.2 त्रिकोणमितीय अनुपात**
समकोण ΔABC में (B पर समकोण), कोण A के लिए:
- sin A = लंब / कर्ण = BC/AC
- cos A = आधार / कर्ण = AB/AC
- tan A = लंब / आधार = BC/AB
व्युत्क्रम: cosec A = 1/sin A, sec A = 1/cos A, cot A = 1/tan A
blocks.body_gu:
**8.2 ત્રિકોણમિતિય ગુણોત્તર**
કાટકોણ ΔABC માં (B કાટખૂણો), ખૂણા A માટે:
- sin A = સામેની બાજુ / કર્ણ = BC/AC
- cos A = પાસેની બાજુ / કર્ણ = AB/AC
- tan A = સામેની બાજુ / પાસેની બાજુ = BC/AB
વ્યસ્ત: cosec=1/sin, sec=1/cos, cot=1/tan

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q1(i): In ΔABC, right-angled at B, AB = 24 cm, BC = 7 cm. Determine sin A and cos A.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र1(i): ΔABC में, B पर समकोण, AB=24, BC=7। sin A और cos A ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q1(i): ΔABC માં, B કાટખૂણો, AB=24, BC=7. sin A અને cos A શોધો.
blocks.explanation: AC² = AB² + BC² = 24² + 7² = 576 + 49 = 625. AC = 25. sin A = BC/AC = 7/25. cos A = AB/AC = 24/25.
blocks.explanation_hi: AC = √(24²+7²) = 25। sin A = लंब/कर्ण = 7/25। cos A = आधार/कर्ण = 24/25।
blocks.explanation_gu: AC = 25. sin A = સામે/કર્ણ = 7/25. cos A = પાસે/કર્ણ = 24/25.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q1(ii): In ΔABC, right-angled at B, AB = 24 cm, BC = 7 cm. Determine sin C and cos C.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र1(ii): ΔABC में, B समकोण, AB=24, BC=7। sin C और cos C ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q1(ii): ΔABC માં, B કાટખૂણો, AB=24, BC=7. sin C અને cos C શોધો.
blocks.explanation: AC = 25. For angle C, opposite side is AB = 24, adjacent is BC = 7. So sin C = AB/AC = 24/25. cos C = BC/AC = 7/25.
blocks.explanation_hi: कोण C के लिए लंब AB(24) और आधार BC(7) है। sin C = 24/25, cos C = 7/25।
blocks.explanation_gu: ખૂણા C માટે સામેની બાજુ AB(24) છે. sin C = 24/25, cos C = 7/25.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q2: In right ΔPQR, PQ = 12 cm, PR = 13 cm. Find tan P – cot R.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र2: समकोण ΔPQR में, PQ=12, PR=13। tan P – cot R ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q2: કાટકોણ ΔPQR માં, PQ=12, PR=13. tan P – cot R શોધો.
blocks.explanation: QR = √(13² - 12²) = 5. tan P = opp/adj = QR/PQ = 5/12. cot R = adj/opp = QR/PQ = 5/12. tan P - cot R = 5/12 - 5/12 = 0.
blocks.explanation_gu: QR = 5. tan P = 5/12, cot R = 5/12. તફાવત 0.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q3: If sin A = 3/4, calculate cos A and tan A.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र3: यदि sin A = 3/4, तो cos A और tan A की गणना करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q3: જો sin A = 3/4, તો cos A અને tan A શોધો.
blocks.explanation: Opposite = 3k, Hypotenuse = 4k. Adjacent = √(16k² - 9k²) = √7k. cos A = √7/4. tan A = 3/√7.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q4: Given 15 cot A = 8, find sin A and sec A.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र4: यदि 15 cot A = 8, तो sin A और sec A ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q4: જો 15 cot A = 8, તો sin A અને sec A શોધો.
blocks.explanation: cot A = 8/15. Adjacent = 8k, Opposite = 15k. Hypotenuse = √(64k² + 225k²) = √289k² = 17k. sin A = 15/17, sec A = 17/8.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q5: Given sec θ = 13/12, calculate all other trigonometric ratios. What is sin θ?
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र5: यदि sec θ = 13/12, तो sin θ क्या होगा?
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q5: જો sec θ = 13/12, તો sin θ શું થશે?
blocks.explanation: sec θ = Hyp/Adj = 13/12. Opp = √(13² - 12²) = 5. sin θ = Opp/Hyp = 5/13. (cos θ = 12/13, tan θ = 5/12, cosec θ = 13/5, cot θ = 12/5).

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q6: If ∠A and ∠B are acute angles such that cos A = cos B, then:
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र6: यदि ∠A और ∠B न्यूनकोण हैं तथा cos A = cos B है, तो:
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q6: જો ∠A અને ∠B લઘુકોણ હોય અને cos A = cos B, તો:
blocks.explanation: In right ΔABC, cos A = AC/AB and cos B = BC/AB. If AC/AB = BC/AB, then AC = BC. Therefore, angles opposite to equal sides are equal: ∠B = ∠A.
blocks.explanation_hi: AC/AB = BC/AB → AC = BC → ∠A = ∠B (समान भुजाओं के सम्मुख कोण)।
blocks.explanation_gu: AC = BC, તેથી સમાન બાજુના સામેના ખૂણા સમાન હોય: ∠A = ∠B.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q7(i): If cot θ = 7/8, evaluate [ (1 + sin θ)(1 - sin θ) ] / [ (1 + cos θ)(1 - cos θ) ].
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र7(i): यदि cot θ = 7/8, तो [ (1 + sin θ)(1 - sin θ) ] / [ (1 + cos θ)(1 - cos θ) ] का मान ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q7(i): જો cot θ = 7/8, તો [ (1 + sin θ)(1 - sin θ) ] / [ (1 + cos θ)(1 - cos θ) ] શોધો.
blocks.explanation: Numerator: 1 - sin²θ = cos²θ. Denominator: 1 - cos²θ = sin²θ. Ratio is (cos²θ)/(sin²θ) = cot²θ. Since cot θ = 7/8, cot²θ = (7/8)² = 49/64.
blocks.explanation_hi: सरल करने पर यह cot²θ बन जाता है = (7/8)² = 49/64।

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q7(ii): If cot θ = 7/8, evaluate cot²θ.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र7(ii): यदि cot θ = 7/8, तो cot²θ का मान?
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q7(ii): જો cot θ = 7/8, તો cot²θ = ?

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q8: If 3 cot A = 4, check whether (1 - tan²A)/(1 + tan²A) = cos²A - sin²A.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र8: यदि 3 cot A = 4, जाँचें कि (1 - tan²A)/(1 + tan²A) = cos²A - sin²A है या नहीं।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q8: જો 3 cot A = 4, તો (1 - tan²A)/(1 + tan²A) = cos²A - sin²A છે કે નહીં?

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q9(i): In ΔABC, ∠B=90°. If tan A = 1/√3, find sin A cos C + cos A sin C.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र9(i): ΔABC में ∠B=90°, tan A = 1/√3। sin A cos C + cos A sin C का मान?
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q9(i): ΔABC માં ∠B=90°, tan A = 1/√3. sin A cos C + cos A sin C શોધો.

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q10: In ΔPQR, ∠Q=90°, PR + QR = 25 and PQ = 5. Find sin P.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र10: ΔPQR में, ∠Q=90°, PR+QR=25, PQ=5। sin P ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q10: ΔPQR માં, ∠Q=90°, PR+QR=25, PQ=5. sin P શોધો.
blocks.explanation: Let QR = x, then PR = 25 - x. PR² = PQ² + QR² → (25 - x)² = 5² + x² → 625 - 50x + x² = 25 + x² → 50x = 600 → x = 12. So QR = 12, PR = 13. sin P = Opp/Hyp = QR/PR = 12/13.
blocks.explanation_hi: पाइथागोरस से: QR=12, PR=13। sin P = 12/13।

blocks.question: Ex 8.1 Q11(i): True or False: The value of tan A is always less than 1.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.1 प्र11(i): सत्य या असत्य: tan A का मान हमेशा 1 से कम होता है।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.1 Q11(i): સાચું કે ખોટું: tan A ની કિંમત હંમેશા 1 કરતાં ઓછી હોય છે.
blocks.explanation: False. tan A = Opposite/Adjacent. The opposite side can be greater than the adjacent side, so tan A can be > 1. (e.g., tan 60° = √3 ≈ 1.732).
blocks.explanation_hi: असत्य। लंब, आधार से बड़ा हो सकता है (जैसे tan 60° = √3 > 1)।
blocks.explanation_gu: ખોટું. સામેની બાજુ પાસેની બાજુ કરતાં મોટી હોઈ શકે.

blocks.body:
**8.3 Trigonometric Ratios of Some Specific Angles**

You must memorize these standard values for 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, and 90°:

*   **sin θ**: 0, 1/2, 1/√2, √3/2, 1
*   **cos θ**: 1, √3/2, 1/√2, 1/2, 0  *(Reverse of sin)*
*   **tan θ**: 0, 1/√3, 1, √3, Not Defined  *(sin/cos)*

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q1(i): Evaluate: sin 60° cos 30° + sin 30° cos 60°
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र1(i): मान ज्ञात करें: sin 60° cos 30° + sin 30° cos 60°
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q1(i): કિંમત શોધો: sin 60° cos 30° + sin 30° cos 60°

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q1(ii): Evaluate: 2 tan² 45° + cos² 30° - sin² 60°
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र1(ii): मान ज्ञात करें: 2 tan² 45° + cos² 30° - sin² 60°
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q1(ii): કિંમત શોધો: 2 tan² 45° + cos² 30° - sin² 60°

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q1(v): Evaluate: [5 cos² 60° + 4 sec² 30° - tan² 45°] / [sin² 30° + cos² 30°]
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र1(v): मान ज्ञात करें: [5 cos² 60° + 4 sec² 30° - tan² 45°] / [sin² 30° + cos² 30°]
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q1(v): કિંમત શોધો: [5 cos² 60° + 4 sec² 30° - tan² 45°] / [sin² 30° + cos² 30°]

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q2(i): 2 tan 30° / (1 + tan² 30°) is equal to:
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र2(i): 2 tan 30° / (1 + tan² 30°) किसके बराबर है?
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q2(i): 2 tan 30° / (1 + tan² 30°) કોના બરાબર છે?
blocks.explanation_hi: मान √3/2 आता है, जो sin 60° है।
blocks.explanation_gu: કિંમત √3/2 મળે છે, જે sin 60° છે.

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q3: If tan (A + B) = √3 and tan (A - B) = 1/√3 (0° < A+B ≤ 90°), find A and B.
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र3: tan (A + B) = √3 और tan (A - B) = 1/√3, A और B ज्ञात करें।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q3: tan (A + B) = √3 અને tan (A - B) = 1/√3, A અને B શોધો.
blocks.explanation: A + B = 60° (since tan 60 = √3). A - B = 30° (since tan 30 = 1/√3). Adding both: 2A = 90° → A = 45°. Then B = 60° - 45° = 15°.

blocks.body:
📋 **Chapter 8 Summary:**

1. In right ΔABC, sin A = opp/hyp, cos A = adj/hyp, tan A = opp/adj.
2. Reciprocals: cosec A = 1/sin A, sec A = 1/cos A, cot A = 1/tan A.
3. Exact values table for 0, 30, 45, 60, 90 degrees must be memorized.
4. **Trigonometric Identities** (covered in Ex 8.3):
   - sin² A + cos² A = 1
   - sec² A - tan² A = 1
   - cosec² A - cot² A = 1
blocks.body_hi:
📋 **अध्याय 8 सारांश:**
1. sin A=लंब/कर्ण, cos A=आधार/कर्ण
2. व्युत्क्रम: cosec=1/sin, sec=1/cos
3. सर्वसमिकाएँ: sin²A+cos²A=1, 1+tan²A=sec²A, 1+cot²A=cosec²A
blocks.body_gu:
📋 **ક. 8 Summary:**
1. sin A=સામે/કર્ણ, cos A=પાસે/કર્ણ
2. નિત્યસમો: sin²A+cos²A=1, 1+tan²A=sec²A, 1+cot²A=cosec²A
